mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals economic distress and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of federal funds rate below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL below 215 (indicating low inflation) signals an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 215, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST rising > 0.5% over 3 months) signals the beginning of a post-recession recovery phase, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST rises > 0.5% over 3 months, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO below 90) indicates economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level below 16000 billion (indicating weak economic growth) signals recessionary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 16000, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) and low employment levels (PAYEMS < 132000) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.5% and PAYEMS < 132000, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 90), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 90, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
